exposure: Affected vs. unaffected offspring of mothers with GCK MODY
glucokinase gene (GCK) and hepatocyte nuclear factor (HNF)-1α MODY mutations
cohort: 37 women with a GCK or HNF-1α MODY mutation (89 pregnancies)
finding: Pregnancies complicated by GCK MODY were more difficult to manage in terms of glycemic control and had a higher percentage of miscarriages compared to HNF-1α MODY pregnancies.
birth_weight: Birthweight was significantly higher in unaffected offspring of mothers with GCK MODY compared to affected offspring.
